title: AI Demand Monitor — hyperscaler capex, contracted backlog and AI-lab commitments
note: Demand side of the AI buildout: what the buyers of capacity disclose. Canonical source for ai-demand-monitor.{md,html}. $B unless noted. Every row carries the date it was disclosed (as_of) and a primary source; sourcing='secondary' marks figures supported only by press accounts. Derived series (q/q, trailing-4Q, run-rate, guide midpoints and revisions, capex-per-contracted-GW) are computed at render time by the refresh script and the HTML from the same formulas, never stored. Research, not P&L. Does not duplicate the neocloud capacity tracker — capacity_crosscheck retains the selected company and tenant rows from MacroGauge's published capacity.json snapshot, with inferred-MW exclusions.
sources_note: Cash capex is FMP statements/cashflow-statement 'investmentsInPropertyPlantAndEquipment' (sign flipped), pulled 2026-10-25. Cross-checks: the five hyperscalers' quarterly figures and closed-year sums against their releases; CRWV against its 10-Q/10-K (H1 2025, 9M 2025, FY2025, H1 2026 cash paid for P&E); NBIS against its shareholder letters and the Q1 2026 financial-statement comparative for Q1 2025. Guide quotes, finance leases, RPO and contracted figures are from the linked releases and filings; guides whose quote comes from the call carry a guide.src and were checked against the FMP earningsTranscript text. Lab-register sizes marked primary link a company, lab or SEC source; secondary rows link the press report (press_src). Perplexity research (2026-10-25/26) located the sources; it is not cited as a source.

basis.qoq: capex[q] / capex[q-1] - 1 (within a company's own series)
basis.ttm: sum of the company's latest four reported quarters of capex (null until four exist)
basis.run_rate: latest reported quarter × 4, per company; the cohort run-rate sums the five hyperscalers' latest quarters, whose period-ends differ (the page prints the span)
basis.guide_mid: (low + high) / 2 for a closed range; a point estimate is its own midpoint. Open-ended bounds and qualitative guides have no midpoint.
basis.guide_revision: Per company and guide fiscal year: last stated minus first stated full-year midpoint, only when both have a midpoint. Implied/carried points are not counted. Open-ended bounds retain their qualifier and produce no exact revision. vs_actual = actual minus last stated midpoint when available.
basis.capex_per_contracted_gw: Hyperscaler cohort run-rate ($B/yr) divided by included tenant MW / 1000 from the published capacity.json snapshot. Explicitly inferred MW and undisclosed MW are excluded. The constituent rows, exclusions and source publication date are retained in capacity_crosscheck. Scale context only, not a forecast or a capacity price.
basis.latest_guide_move: Last stated full-year midpoint minus the previous stated midpoint for the same year; null when only one exists or either guide is open-ended.
